hits.name: Logistics Specialist (16 Months Contact)
hits.description: Our mission is to support operational excellence by aligning daily logistics activities with central, zone, and local strategies, while upholding our brand values and fostering strong collaboration
hits.jobResponsabilities:
Handling of Import shipments

  1. Manage inbound transportation of merchandising shipments to ensure smooth end-to-end delivery
  2. Handle issues related to bonded transportation, missing/damaged cartons and offloaded shipment
  3. Proceed missing/damage claim to airlines, 3PL or forwarding company if necessary
  4. Submit CITES/ WILD permit for restricted products and follow up with ETA
  5. Conduct special consumption tax exemption
  6. Proceed ATA Carnet issurance and oversee export process accordingly

Import Entry Management

  1. Ensure full regulatory compliance across import shipment in accordance to split rule
  2. Understand updated trade rules and ensure correct classification (HS code)
  3. Apply FTA preferential rate and review documentation in preparation for a customs audit
  4. Verify duty & VAT savings on monthly basis
  5. Regularly perform risk assessments for import customs clearance with import broker

Vendor/ Transaction Management

  1. Review inbound processes and identify opportunities to improve leadtime
  2. Monitor in-transit orders and liase with HQ to ensure all orders are excuted
  3. Monitor customs broker performance and ensure service quality and entry accuracy

Monthly Closing

  1. Duty & VAT and vendor payment on monthly basis
  2. Bi-weekly intercompany payment
  3. Monthly duty & VAT assessment by category level
hits.profile:
Min 5 years of Inbound Logistics experience
Retail experience preferred but not mandatory
BA degree or above
Good command of English, SAP experiences, Good knowledge of Import
Open minded & fast learner

You’ll be a key driver of store success- leading by example to inspire your team, elevate client experiences, and exceed goals. Through coaching, collaboration, and a passion for beauty, you’ll help create a high-performing, inclusive environment where everyone thrives. If you’re a natural leader with a client-first mindset, this is your moment to Belong to Something Beautiful.
